PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:   The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.  KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.  Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.  One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.  OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.  REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).  Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:   Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.  In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect featuresas single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments. In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines. Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency. Participate in change management and project planning activities. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system. Requirements 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience. MUST BE fluent in English. Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management. Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management. Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting. Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues. Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions. Preferred Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects. Experience with enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php
description:

Quem somos? Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;  Experiência de2+ anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;  Experiência de2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;  Experiência de2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;  Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);  Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;  Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);  Conhecimento sólido emGit e versionamento de código;  Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);  Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.   Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.    Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.    Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.    Other duties, as assigned.   Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview: The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students. Core Responsibilities: Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family. Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration. Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments. Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children. Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs. Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers. Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented). Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge. Collaboration Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension. Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports. Monitor students’ progress and well-being. Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners. Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning. Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children. Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning. Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load. Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed. Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks. Operational and Professional Conduct Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies. Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress. Maintain accurate student records. Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods. Participate in professional development opportunities. Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned. Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines. Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide. Other duties, as assigned. Working Conditions: Walk on paths and rough terrain May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up POSITION REQUIREMENTS Minimum Education Required: BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent Minimum Experience Required: Five years of teaching experience, preferred Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences. Experience working in a school setting or educational environment. Specific Knowledge: Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners. Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented. Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards. description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista De Desenvolvimento De Métodos Analíticos - Físico-Químico em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bionovis, trabalhamos com o propósito de ampliar o acesso da população brasileira a medicamentos inovadores, seguindo sempre os mais rigorosos padrões científicos, técnicos e éticos. "Somos uma comunidade voltada para um propósito, não apenas uma empresa." Serão desafios desse profissional: Realizar a elaboração, revisão e execução de metodologias analíticas no laboratório de Controle de Qualidade Físico-Químico, implementando novos processos e metodologias, além de atuar na rotina de análises executando e suportando as atividades analíticas do laboratório. Para concorrer a vaga, você deve ter: Experiência em técnicas instrumentais físico químicas como HPLC, espectrofotometria UV-Vis, titulação entre outras;  Conhecimento em transferência, desenvolvimento, validação de métodos analíticos e normas regulatórias nacionais e internacionais;  Familiaridade com análise estatística aplicada à validação e controle de métodos analíticos;  Experiência com elaboração de documentação técnica, como protocolos e relatórios analíticos;  Participar e apoiar os processos de investigação laboratorial para resultados não conforme através de técnicas e ferramentas de investigação de desvio (Ex: 6Ms, Ishikawa);  Experiência com sistema de gerenciamento de laboratório (LIMS), preferencialmente no SampleManager da Thermo;  Conhecimento no sistema de gestão de documentos SE Suite;  Conhecimento do pacote office com ênfase em Excel;  Conhecimento sistema integrado (Ex. SAP);  Conhecimento no software Empower e Lab Solutions; . Noções em processo farmacêutico biológico. Ensino superior completo em Farmácia, Química, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia ou áreas relacionadas. Inglês Avançado será considerado um diferencial. Nossos benefícios: VT ou estacionamento no local Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco (extensivo a cônjuge e filhos menores) Seguro de Vida Vale Alimentação R$ 760,00 / mês Restaurante no local (sem desconto para o colaborador) Wellbhub (Gympass) Desconto em medicamentos (Vidalink) Convênio com escola de Idiomas e Universidades Desconto em conta de energia elétrica (CPFL Paulista, Cemig e Light) Programa de Apoio à Saúde Física e Emocional (PAE e Avatar da Saúde) PLR conforme metas Cartão cesta de Natal Horário de trabalho: De segunda à sexta-feira das 14h30m às 23h15m Na Bionovis somos diversos e valorizamos o respeito e a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades, que fazem cada pessoa única, incluindo: Pessoas com deficiência, Raça e Etnia, Idade, Gênero, Crenças, Orientação sexual e Identidade de gênero.

title: Analista De Inteligência De Negócios
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista De Inteligência De Negócios em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Resumo do Cargo Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Assistente de Contabilidade abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso! description:
Empresa está contratando Liquidity Partnership Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Treasury Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) - Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. - Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. - Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. - Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. - Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. - Job Description Make the world your home. It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.What we offer Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589)  per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world   The Role As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction  What you'll bring To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1)  A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum  (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDSAdditional Information Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our "Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.To learn more visit  Recruitment Fraud Alert  Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Advogado
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Advogado em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, futuro(a) ADVOGADO PLENO/SÊNIOR ✨  Somos uma empresa líder no setor de saúde, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras que salvam vidas e melhoram a qualidade do atendimento a pacientes em todo o país. Buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno/Sênior estratégico e proativo para integrar nosso departamento jurídico interno, garantindo a segurança legal e o sucesso das nossas operações junto à Administração Pública e Hospitais particulares.  Resumo da Vaga  O(a) profissional será o(a) principal parceiro(a) jurídico(a) da área comercial no que tange ao mercado público. Terá atuação de destaque na análise e gestão de contratos administrativos, mitigação de riscos e elaboração de teses jurídicas para defender os interesses da empresa em certames licitatórios e processos cíveis.    Principais Responsabilidades  Elaboração de Peças: Redigir impugnações a editais, recursos administrativos, contrarrazões, pedidos de esclarecimento e representações junto à Administração Pública, Ministério Público e Tribunais de Contas. Gestão de Contratos Administrativos: Atuar na análise, negociação e gestão de contratos com o Poder Público, elaborando aditivos, pedidos de prorrogação e pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro. Gestão de Contratos Particulares: Atuar na análise, negociação e gestão de contratos particulares, pedidos de prorrogação e pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro. Consultoria Interna: Prestar suporte jurídico consultivo diário para as demais áreas internas da empresa. Atuação em processos cíveis diversos, elaborando peças processuais diversas e participando em audiências.  Compliance e Regulação:  Garantir que os contratos estejam em conformidade com as regras de compliance da empresa e com as normativas do setor de saúde.    Requisitos e Qualificações  Formação superior completa em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB. Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 05 anos de experiência comprovada em Direito Administrativo, com foco majoritário em licitações e contratos. Domínio Legislativo: Conhecimento profundo da Nova Lei de Licitações (Lei nº 14.133/21), além da Lei nº 8.666/93, 10.520/02 e Lei das Estatais (Lei nº 13.303/16). Vivência no Setor de Saúde: Experiência prévia atuando com licitações no segmento médico, farmacêutico, hospitalar ou de Life Sciences. Habilidade de negociação, visão de negócios e capacidade de traduzir riscos jurídicos em orientações práticas para lideranças não jurídicas. Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.  ⭐ Diferenciais  Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Direito Administrativo, Direito Público ou Direito Médico. Conhecimento das normas de Compliance na relação público-privada (Lei Anticorrupção - Lei nº 12.846/13).   O que oferecemos:  Salário: Enviar pretensão salarial Jornada: Segunda a Sexta Horário: 08h às 17h Local de trabalho: SKY Galleria (Campinas/SP) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) Regime de contratação: CLT Plano de carreira Cesta básica: R$ 250,00 Vale refeição: Total de R$ 32,00/dia Vale transporte: C/ desconto 6% ou Auxílio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 Cartão Flexível: Benefícios pagos via Sólides (Mastercard) Convênio Farmácia: Crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha Confraternizações: Coffee Break na última quarta-feira do mês Parcerias Educacionais: Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna Convênios: Médico e odontológico (após período de experiência). Gympass    E aí, topa o desafio?  Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "    Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!    A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em  Endocrinologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.   * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:  *   A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.   * O QUE PROCURAMOS:  *   Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em  Endocrinologia  , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;     DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:     Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em  Endocrinologia   de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.     Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios  Endocrinológicos  .     Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em  Endocrinologia   e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.     Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.     Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.     Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças  Endocrinológicas  .     Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.     Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.     Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.     Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em  Endocrinologia.      Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.     Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.     Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.     Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.     Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.     Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.     Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.     REQUISITOS     Formação Acadêmica:    Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA   RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM  ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.      Certificações:    Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);    Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em  Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.    Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).     Experiência:    Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em  Endocrinologia  , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;     Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:    Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com  doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..     Competências Comportamentais:    Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.    Outros Requisitos Importantes:    Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.    Local de Trabalho:    REMOTO    I  MPORTANTE:     MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:   Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.    REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS   : a negociar durante processo seletivo.    Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em  Endocrinologia.

Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado à resolução de problemas. Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Somos uma empresa de vistorias de imóveis, atendendo em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida de um ativo imobiliário, com capacidade de atuação em todo o Brasil.  Fazemos isso construindo uma experiência de excelência através de uma solução inovadora que integra uma plataforma digital com peritos especializados para trazer agilidade, transparência e segurança às partes envolvidas (construtoras, condomínios, imobiliárias e instituições financeiras, e seus clientes). Buscamos ser a maior e mais respeitada empresa de vistorias em ativos imobiliários do mundo.  Aqui na Rede damos muita importância aos nossos valores organizacionais (CASAEPIC). Confiança - CONFIAMOS UNS NOS OUTROS; Agilidade - SOMOS ACELERADOS; Sucesso do Cliente - O SUCESSO DO NOSSO CLIENTE É O NOSSO SUCESSO; Alegria - AGIMOS SEMPRE COM ALEGRIA E PAIXÃO PELO O QUE FAZEMOS; Eficácia - AQUI A GENTE RESOLVE; Pensar Grande - SOMOS MOVIDOS A DESAFIOS; Inovação - SOMOS MOVIDOS POR INOVAÇÃO E A MUDANÇA É CONSTANTE; Cooperação - JUNTOS MELHORAMOS E CRESCEMOS SEMPRE.  A função de vistoriador tem papel fundamental na Rede Vistorias pois é execução do serviço de vistoria. A equipe de vistoriadores é a base de toda a Rede Vistorias e representa atransformação da expectativa em realidade junto ao mercado imobiliário.  As principais atividades dessa função são: Realizar os serviços de vistorias de ativos imobiliários de forma eficiente, precisa e fidedigna, analisando características e estados de conservação/funcionamento de imóveis comerciais e residenciais, novos e usados; Identificar e observar os materiais, acabamentos, instalações elétricas e hidráulicas, mobília e demais itens do imóvel; Realizar testes em equipamentos, identificar danos e verificar o funcionamento e condições do ambiente em geral; Nas vistorias de saída, efetuar comparações minuciosas com base em relatórios e documentos; Registrar as informações captadas em forma de texto detalhado com fotos para elaboração do relatório de vistoria através de aplicativo para tablet; Realizar conferência de reparos e divergências; Realizar treinamento e acompanhamento de novos vistoriadores.   Pré-requisitos: Ensino médio completo; Conhecimentos básicos em informática; Carteira de habilitação e veículo (moto ou carro); Celular sistema Android.   Habilidades e Competências: Comunicação escrita e oral clara e objetiva; Visão Sistêmica; Orientação a Resultados; Liderança. Sobre nós - Grupo Revise  O Grupo Revise, atua há mais de 29 anos no setor automotivo brasileiro, destaca-se pela qualidade certificada e pelo pioneirismo. Como uma empresa 100% brasileira, possui 3 marcas, sendo: (Brazzo, Mobato e Varimax), com 6 centros de distribuição estratégicos em todo o país e um amplo portfólio que inclui milhares de itens de alta qualidade em prol da satisfação dos clientes, reforçados pela certificação ISO 9001:2015.   SOBRE A MOBATO  A Mobato é uma marca que oferece soluções digitais para conectar clientes ao setor automotivo, com adaptabilidade a diversas plataformas tecnológicas e integração a sistemas ERP s e DMS s. Suas soluções digitais visam transformar o atendimento de serviços em uma experiência rápida e eficiente, eliminando burocracias e proporcionando agilidade. Priorizando a satisfação do cliente, a Mobato busca compreender suas necessidades para garantir a prosperidade dos negócios. Vem ser MOBATO!    Principais responsabilidades:   Definir a estratégia de testes: Projetar a estratégia geral de testes, determinando o equilíbrio adequado entre testes unitários, de API e de interface do usuário, e garantindo que a automação seja integrada ao pipeline de desenvolvimento (CI/CD).  Mapear riscos e priorizar esforços: Identificar riscos potenciais do software e priorizar as atividades de teste nas áreas mais críticas do sistema onde as falhas teriam maior impacto no negócio.  Revisar requisitos e critérios de aceite: Trabalhar em conjunto com Product Owners (POs) e equipes de desenvolvimento para definir critérios de aceite claros e garantir que os requisitos de qualidade sejam compreendidos por todos.  Monitorar métricas de qualidade: Acompanhar e relatar regularmente as métricas de qualidade, como cobertura de testes, defeitos encontrados e resolução de problemas, para que a gerência possa tomar ações corretivas.  Liderar e coordenar o time: Supervisionar a equipe de QA, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e engajamento.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico: Orientar os membros da equipe, realizar reuniões individuais (1:1), fornecer feedbacks e apoiar o crescimento técnico individual.  Disseminar boas práticas: Promover a cultura de qualidade em toda a organização e incentivar a adoção de boas práticas de QA e engenharia de software.       O que esperamos de você:   Experiência consolidada em testes de software (manuais e automatizados).   Vivência com liderança de equipe de QA.     Experiência com automação de testes utilizando ferramentas como Katalon, Selenium, Cypress ou Playwright.     Testes de APIs REST com ferramentas como Postman e Newman.     Conhecimento de processos de CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines.     Acompanhamento e gestão de métricas de qualidade (tempo de ciclo, taxa de defeitos, cobertura de testes, lead time, throughput).     Visão sistêmica, compreendendo o fluxo completo de desenvolvimento e qualidade.     Pensamento crítico para identificar falhas e riscos que impactam o produto final.     Capacidade de análise e melhoria contínua baseada em indicadores e dados.
